description: An optional fallback for an app with no MMP (AppsFlyer, Adjust…) and no revenue SDK that collects Apple Ads attribution; Apptiller otherwise reads attribution from the tools already connected. Creates this organization's Apptiller ingest key and returns a Swift function to add to the iOS app. The app then sends each install's Apple AdServices token to Apptiller, which resolves it with Apple: which Apple Ads campaign, ad group, keyword and ad brought the install, for Advanced and Basic accounts alike, with no third-party SDK and no tracking prompt. Calling it again replaces the key; apps with the old key stop counting until updated.
name: attribution_setup
title: Set up Apple Ads attribution
